page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review rules. Link them to agents; enabled skills are added to the agent's prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Write a skill or import one from a .md / .zip file.

card.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It will be removed from every agent. This cannot be undone.

preview.untrustedNotice: A skill is instructions for the model. Its body is placed into the prompt of every agent it is linked to — read it before enabling it.

editor.subtitle: A skill is a reusable rule that is added to an agent's prompt.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Apply when a PR adds or changes tests; check that they assert behaviour, not implementation.
fields.descriptionHint: The description is the skill's interface: the model decides from it when to apply the skill. Write it as a directive — when to apply it and what to check.
fields.enabledHint: Whether this skill is added to the prompts of agents it is linked to.
fields.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new version.

import.title: Import skill from file
import.subtitle: Upload a SKILL.md or a .zip containing one. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.dropHint: Drop a SKILL.md or .zip here, or pick a file
import.trustBody: An imported skill is someone else's instructions. Once saved and linked to an agent, its text is placed into that agent's prompt. Read it carefully before you save.
import.ignoredHint: These files in the archive were not read and will never be run.

versions.title: Versions
versions.hint: A new version is created only when the body changes. Restoring an earlier version adds it as a new version; nothing is deleted.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? Its body becomes the current body, saved as a new version.
versions.restoredNoop: v{version} is already the current body.
versions.tooLarge: These versions are too large to diff here.
